searchText: MSRP $362,299. New 2027 Thor Motor Coach Pasadena 34XG Model. Optional Features 400 Watt Additional Solar Charging System  This luxury Super C is approximately 35 feet 6 inches in length with a Freightliner chassis, Cummins 6.7L ISB engine w/360HP, Tilt-A-View inclining King Bed, stainless residential refrigerator with ice maker, exterior entertainment center, and a spacious dream dinette. This beautiful motorhome includes upgraded features such as the dual 15K BTU A/Cs with dual heat pumps, solar charging now monitored through the Firefly monitor panel, shower miser, Oxygenics shower head, new hardwood cabinet doors, new decorative mirror and the upgraded storage box in home theater seating. The Pasadena has an incredible list of standard features including the air-ride suspension, full-hydraulic automatic leveling jack system, 8KW Onan diesel generator, solar panel, tankless water heater, legless power patio awning, frameless dual pane windows, Winegard ConnecT 4G Wi-Fi System, front overhead bunk vent with shade, AGS15 wall mounted LCD system panel screen, manual e-start switch in dash and much more.
